description: Mobile capabilities for the trusted Shiori main webview. `mobile-app-commands` is backed by the build.rs application manifest and scoped by webview label (NOT window), so only `main` gets the minimal mobile command set. Store builds deliberately omit desktop-native path, terminal, updater, and process-plugin permissions. The Browser panel's native WKWebView / Android WebView is not a Tauri webview and remains outside this ACL.
